name: Ganges river dolphin skeleton, museum specimen C 272
creator: Patrizia17 / Natural History Museum of the University of Pisa
usage: Life world shushuk anatomy example only. It is a museum skeleton scan, not a living dolphin or a full-body soft-tissue depiction.
provenance: Downloaded from Wikimedia Commons. Converted from binary STL to GLB, normalized and simplified for web delivery; the adapted asset remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
modifications: Converted binary STL to a single-mesh GLB.
Normalized the longest source dimension to 1.7 scene units.
Simplified the triangle mesh with Meshoptimizer to 114,962 triangles; reported relative error 0.0033989.
Recomputed smooth vertex normals and assigned a neutral bone material.
limitations: The scan represents bones only; it does not show skin, fins, organs, color, movement, or a live animal.
The source is a museum specimen scan, not a specimen collected in Bangladesh.
The source and adapted mesh are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution.
